prompt: New chat; first message is a pasted handoff block for a family budget sheet
assertions: Short confirmation of understanding (no long restatement of the whole block)
Does not suggest budgeting apps (YNAB, Mint, etc.)
Does not use macros or Apps Script
Does not re-ask questions the block already answers (currency, categories, tool choice)
Starts NEXT STEP 1: gives a SUMIF formula for remaining = limit - spent
Explains the formula step by step for a non-technical user
Does not jump ahead to steps 2-3 in full detail before step 1 is done
